id: title:Gilbert09:stop reporting a transient app db blip as a bug

review.posthog_relevance: Adds exception handling and tests for database connection errors, potentially improving reliability of database-dependent PostHog components.
review.reason: Adds exception handling for OperationalError and InterfaceError, and adds a test for persistent DB connection errors. P1.F1.H2 adds a warning log and returns False without reporting the error to PostHog's error tracking, treating transient DB connection errors as non-reportable. P1.F2.H2 adds a test to verify that persistent DB connection errors are not reported to PostHog's error.
